title: DarGlobal — company overview
content: DarGlobal is a London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor and asset manager. It creates high-quality communities, landmark destinations and lifestyle-driven assets across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and London. Its portfolio spans premium hospitality, commercial, entertainment and exclusive golf communities. DarGlobal describes its approach as owning, investing, developing and operating high-end real estate with global partnerships. The homepage states a 32-year track record, $23 billion gross development value, 7 international markets and 12+ global brand partners, with data indicative of disclosures as of Q3 2026. Official website: https://darglobal.co.uk/

title: DarGlobal — highlighted projects and business areas
content: DarGlobal homepage highlights AIDA, a masterplan in Oman; Trump International Simaisma in Qatar; and Trump Mansions in Wadi Safar, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. DarGlobal describes its business areas as building luxury communities, hospitality and leisure, private membership, golf, commercial real estate, asset management and real estate tokenization. It says it develops architecturally distinctive residential and mixed-use assets in global markets. Official source: https://darglobal.co.uk/

title: DarGlobal — recent newsroom items shown on homepage
content: DarGlobal's homepage newsroom shows a November 16, 2026 announcement of a new mixed-use development in Jeddah valued at SAR 1 billion; an October 7, 2026 announcement opening sales for Trump Villas at Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar; and a June 29, 2026 announcement with FENDI Casa for Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman. These are homepage newsroom announcements; confirm details and current status on the official site. Official source: https://darglobal.co.uk/

title: Wasalt — platform overview
content: Wasalt is a Saudi-based real estate platform for discovering properties, exploring opportunities and connecting with property experts across Saudi Arabia. Its public homepage offers Buy, Rent, Projects, Daily Rentals and Barter categories. It describes the platform as AI-backed and says it supports verified properties and trusted brokers. The site displays REGA license number 1200016591 and Ministry of Tourism license number 73106008. Official website: https://wasalt.sa/en

title: Wasalt — property services and features
content: Wasalt's homepage describes property listings for sale or rent, daily rentals, projects, auctions, and matching property seekers with property experts. Its Matchmaker feature matches leads based on property type, purpose, district and category of a live listing. Wasalt Auctions includes timed auctions where bidders compete to determine a final sale price, including auctions with Infath. To list a property, users create an account, enter property details, upload photos and set prices, primarily through the Wasalt app, business app or website. Official source: https://wasalt.sa/en

title: Wasalt — common property search categories
content: Wasalt's public homepage links to Saudi property searches including villas for sale, apartments for sale, properties for rent, luxury villas for rent, luxury apartments, land for sale, and property searches in Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, Dammam, Al Khobar and Khamis Mushayt. District examples linked from the homepage include Al Rimal, Al Olaya, Al Yasmeen, Al Khaleej and Al Nakheel in Riyadh. The homepage does not itself provide a complete live inventory or guarantee current listing availability. Official source: https://wasalt.sa/en
